period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis, from First Security Islami Bank PLC's own Condensed Balance Sheet (Un-audited) as at 2021-03-31. Income-statement items with a '_cumulative' suffix are cumulative from 1 January of the same year; items with a '_discrete_q' suffix are the single discrete quarter alone -- both are printed directly as separate columns in the source document (not derived by subtraction), so both carry basis='reported'. First Q1 interim figure added for this bank (previously only Q4/annual data existed). The comparative prior-year-end Total Assets column in this filing cross-validates exactly (to the taka, after rounding) against this dataset's already-stored 496,425.48mn (2020_Q4.json) total_assets figure, confirming Solo basis continuity and no restatement between the audited annual figure and this interim filing's own comparative column. Income-statement items are for Jan-Mar 2021 only (cumulative-from-Jan-1 and discrete-Q1 are identical for a first quarter). Pre-crisis period: business as usual, years before the FY2024 collapse.

line_items.metric_note: Simple Investment/Deposit calculation per this dataset's standard formula (methodology.md). This does NOT match the bank's own regulatory-basis 'Investment Deposit Ratio' as separately disclosed in annual reports (e.g. FY2024 annual reports 122.25% vs this simple calculation giving ~141% at FY2024 year-end) -- the bank's own regulatory ratio evidently uses a different deposit/investment base (e.g. including borrowings or a regulatory-defined denominator) not disclosed in these condensed interim statements. Recorded as a internally-consistent, comparable-across-quarters proxy, not as a reproduction of the bank's own regulatory ratio.
